groups.duckdb_error_raw:
FATAL Error: Failed to create checkpoint because of error: failed to pin block of size 1.0 MiB (182.8 MiB/183.1 MiB used)

Possible solutions:
* Reducing the number of threads (SET threads=X)
* Disabling insertion-order preservation (SET preserve_insertion_order=false)
* Increasing the memory limit (SET memory_limit='...GB')

See also https://duckdb.org/docs/current/guides/performance/how_to_tune_workloads

notes: 实验记录器：失败/溢写/成功都是有效证据，不判失败；只断言设置生效与条数自洽
192MB 是 DB 缓冲管理器的过渡基线，不是 RSS 预算（ADR-012）
单机单次样本不构成预算冻结；M1 校准（大载荷 1 MiB、长时、temp_directory 溢写验证）是 ADR-012 退出条件
